hooks.line: To a chatbot, strawberry can be one number.
AI chatbots don't read letters at all.
Why did chatbots miscount the Rs in strawberry?

notes: Voice Holden (Grady takes ran 11-13 s for these lines). First sentence ends at 2.7 s: sentence one lifted 1.10 and a 1.3 s beat added after it so the centred speech starts at 0.34 s. No hook retry: balance after the video was under 250.
